name: Kitgenix PDF Invoicing for WooCommerce
author: Kitgenix

sections.description:
Kitgenix PDF Invoicing for WooCommerce is a lightweight, modular PDF invoicing plugin built for speed, security and compatibility with WooCommerce stores.

Built to be developer-friendly and review-ready, the plugin provides:

  • Automated PDF generation for invoices, receipts, packing slips and credit notes.
  • Stable document numbering and history for invoices and credit notes.
  • Templating system with theme override support and a plugin-provided standard template set.
  • Dompdf-based PDF rendering with chrooted reads and remote-fetch disabled by default for security.
  • Filters and actions for full extensibility (filename, HTML, enabled types, streaming hooks).
  • Email attachment integration that generates PDFs on demand and cleans up temp files.
  • Admin meta box with quick preview, stream and generate actions protected by nonces and capability checks.

Why Kitgenix PDF Invoicing?

  • Security-first: nonces, capability checks, strict sanitization/escaping and Dompdf PHP execution disabled by default.
  • Lightweight: only generates PDFs when needed, writes to secure temp files and removes them after use.
  • Extensible: filters and actions let developers customise filenames, templates, document availability and more.
  • WooCommerce-ready: designed specifically for order-level PDF documents and email attachments.

Features

  • Generate PDF invoices, receipts, packing slips and credit notes
  • Stable invoice numbering and date preservation on first generation
  • Credit note history tied to refunds
  • Theme override support and plugin fallback templates
  • Safe Dompdf configuration (chroot, remote fetch off, PHP execution opt-in)
  • Email attachment integration with automatic temp file cleanup
  • Admin preview, stream (download/view) and file generation endpoints with nonces and capability checks
  • Developer filters: kitgenix_pdf_document_filename, kitgenix_pdf_document_html, kitgenix_pdf_document_enabled, and more

External Services

This plugin leverages the bundled Dompdf library to render HTML to PDF. Dompdf may access local files under configured chroot paths (plugin path and the uploads directory). Remote fetching is disabled by default to avoid SSRF or remote resource risks.

Security & Privacy

  • Nonces and capability checks protect admin endpoints and meta box actions.
  • Inputs are sanitized and all template outputs use appropriate escaping functions (esc_html, esc_attr, wp_kses_post, etc.).
  • Temporary PDF files are created in the system temp directory and removed automatically.
  • Dompdf PHP evaluation is disabled by default; enable only with add_filter( 'kitgenix_dompdf_enable_php', '__return_true' ); and add admin-level documentation or warnings if enabling.

Developers

Filters and actions of interest:

  • kitgenix_pdf_invoicing_modules — Filter the list of registered modules.
  • kitgenix_pdf_document_html — Filter rendered HTML before it is passed to Dompdf.
  • kitgenix_pdf_document_filename — Filter generated PDF filename.
  • kitgenix_pdf_document_enabled — Control whether a document type is enabled for a specific order.
  • kitgenix_before_stream_pdf_document, kitgenix_after_stream_pdf_document — Hooks around streaming.
  • kitgenix_dompdf_enable_php — Opt in to Dompdf PHP evaluation (disabled by default).

Uninstall

The plugin includes an uninstall.php that removes the plugin settings option (kitgenix_pdf_invoicing_settings) when uninstalled via WordPress. Order meta and other historical order data are intentionally preserved to avoid accidental data loss.

Bundled libraries: Dompdf and its dependencies (see vendor/ for licenses).

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New if packaged for WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active — the plugin adds a helpful admin notice if WooCommerce is missing.
  4. Visit WooCommerce → Orders and open an order to preview or download PDFs via the Kitgenix meta box.
  5. Configure templates optionally by copying templates/standard/ into your theme under kitgenix-pdf-invoicing-for-woocommerce/standard/ and editing the files.
sections.faq:
Is Dompdf bundled and safe to use?

Yes — Dompdf is bundled for convenience. The plugin configures Dompdf to use a safe chrooted file list and disables remote fetching by default. Executing PHP inside Dompdf templates is disabled by default; site owners who understand the risk can opt-in via the kitgenix_dompdf_enable_php filter.

How do I override templates?

Copy the file you want to override from templates/standard/ into your theme at kitgenix-pdf-invoicing-for-woocommerce/standard/ and edit it. The plugin will use the theme file in preference to the bundled template.

Are PDFs stored in uploads?

No. PDFs are generated to a secure system temp file and streamed to the browser or attached to emails. Temp files are removed on shutdown or by the email cleanup handler.

Can I attach PDFs to WooCommerce emails?

Yes. The plugin provides settings and filters to attach chosen document types to email notifications. Generated files are created temporarily and deleted automatically.

How are invoice numbers handled?

Invoice and receipt numbers are persisted on the order when generated for the first time so documents remain stable. Credit notes are tied to refund history.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 19 December 2025

  • Initial release — modular PDF invoicing for WooCommerce:
  • Generate PDF invoices, receipts, packing slips and credit notes
  • Standard standard template set (invoice, receipt, packing-slip, credit-note) with HTML wrapper and CSS
  • Theme override support (copy templates/standard/ into your theme to customise templates)
  • Dompdf-based PDF rendering with secure defaults (chrooted paths, remote fetch disabled by default, PHP evaluation opt-in)
  • Email integration to attach generated PDFs to WooCommerce emails with automatic temporary file cleanup
  • Admin order meta box with invoice number display, preview, stream (view/download) and generate/re-generate actions (nonces and capability checks)
  • Settings UI to enable/disable document types, select templates, control email attachments, and set company details/logo
  • Stable invoice numbering persisted to orders on first generation; credit notes tied to refund history
  • Developer-friendly filters and actions for filename, rendered HTML, enabled document types, streaming hooks and module registration
  • Translations-ready and localisation support (see languages/)
  • Secure temporary file handling and an uninstall routine that removes plugin settings while preserving order history
